paragraphs: ReadyOp is a web-based platform that combines planning, operations, communications, visual displays and reporting forms in a single system. The site states that the platform is encrypted, works across agencies, and requires no hardware or software.

Capabilities listed on the site include incident command, continuity of operations, gunshot detection, and multi-agency coordination. Other listed items cover alerts and notifications, checklists and reporting, real time information sharing, and interfaces to ESRI and WebEOC.

The homepage says the platform is used by government agencies, hospitals, ports and airports, first responders, schools and universities, companies and unified commands. A list headed Who Uses ReadyOp names Department of Health, Local Government Agencies, and State and Federal Agencies.

quote.text: ReadyOp is used nationwide by agencies and organizations of all sizes and types.
